ENTA / IDENTITY

Wordmark: Custom interconnected lowercase letterforms ("enta").
Symbol: Isometric dimensional arch and focal diagonal beam.

INK #141318
ELECTRIC VIOLET #4931DE
CORNFLOWER #4F80EF
LAVENDER #C7C4FF
WHITE #FFFFFF

Display: Anton Regular. Body: Inter Variable. Both licensed under the SIL Open Font License; bundled in the website assets.

Use light marks on dark surfaces and dark/violet marks on light surfaces. Keep clear space around the symbol and wordmark. Avoid shadows, bevels, and stretching.
